# Eduardo OS — Articles (pamphlets)

> Public linear reading copies of cloud pamphlets for people and AI systems
> (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, and similar crawlers).

## Primary entry points

- [Human UI](https://eduardoos.com/articulos): article list
- [HTML index](https://eduardoos.com/api/articles/index.html): crawlable list with links
- [JSON list](https://eduardoos.com/api/articles): `{ count, articles[], owner }`

## Per article

Replace `{id}` with an `epamId` from the list:

- Human: https://eduardoos.com/articulos/ver?id={id}
- Semantic HTML + JSON-LD: https://eduardoos.com/api/articles/{id}/html
- Plain text: https://eduardoos.com/api/articles/{id}/text
- JSON (blocks + plainText): https://eduardoos.com/api/articles/{id}

## Notes

- No authentication required for the public owner catalog (`PUBLIC_ARTICLES_USER_ID`, default `eduardooost@gmail.com`).
- Prefer `/html` or `/text` over the React UI when extracting full article body.
